data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘rafa’ which means ‘to raise, lift up, or be high’. The name Raoofah is considered to be a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl, signifying her connection to the divine and her potential to soar to great heights. The name Raoofah carries the meaning “Heavenly, Skyward” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raoofah usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly, skyward and live with faith, good character and purpose.
